meta.title: Whale Sentinel
meta.description: Whale Sentinel (小鲸哨): a lightweight DSH task radar. Collapsed, the mascot sits at her desk; once the panel opens she stands beside it, gripping the edge and pointing at the tasks. Pending / Running / Results are clickable tabs with arrow-key support, and each task shows its workspace and running subagents. While you are on the DSH page, reminders stay in the panel and the system notice is withdrawn; simultaneous completions fold into one toast. Failed reminders retry, a missing click bridge degrades to notification-only, and a corrupt settings file falls back to safe defaults. Does not modify the DSH core.
